content.text: Submitted. The repair adds the absent TrueLink indemnity as new clause 12.c (third-party IP infringement of the Interface/Hosting/Support Services/deliverables, TrueLink's breach of law, TrueLink-caused Client Content breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice, control and cooperation) and closes the previously unmet preferred limb with a single in-sentence insertion narrowing Client's 12.a indemnity to Client Content and Client's breach of applicable law. Non-preferred extras (modification/combination carve-out, settlement mechanics, expense allocation) were dropped to keep the change minimal and level-pure.
